newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul central bank sells dlrs forward at 919 won.
newsitem.headline: Seoul central bank sells dlrs forward at 919 won.

text.p: South Korea's central bank sold dollars one-year forward at 919 won in Wednesday morning trading to limit the won's fall, dealers said.
It was the second intervention on Wednesday following a decision by local banks on Tuesday to bail out the financially troubled Kia Group, dealers said.
Dealers said the central bank sold at least $50 million in the forward market, but they added that the two interventions did not seem to hamper dollar buying sentiment.
The won rose to 891.60 following the central bank's first intervention in the spot market but soon weakened to 892.20.
The won opened at 892.20 on Wednesday against its Tuesday closing level of 891.90.
